_about: Machine-checkable resolution specs for paper calls, keyed by memdb id. Written 2026-11-22 from each call's resolution_rule (research_notes/Paper calls/batch1.md, batch2.md; pilot calls from their titles). type: a=reported number vs threshold, b=price/relative return, c=corporate event, d=human judgment. auto: structured (resolver may decide), assisted (resolver gathers evidence + proposes; a human confirms in review_decisions.jsonl), human. A spec never changes a call's rule: if a spec and the written rule disagree, the written rule wins and the spec is fixed.
_periods: India Q3 FY27 = quarter ended 2026-12-31; FY27 = 2026-04-01..2027-03-31. check_from = first day the resolver looks for data.
